QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Awkward Celebration
QuestInfo.0: Take Spiegelmann's flowers to Madame Ming to congratulate her on the opening of Fantasy Theme World, the newest branch in her line of theme parks.
QuestInfo.1: Get to the #eEast side of Ludibrium#n and take the #b#eCable Car#n#k to Fantasy Theme World to deliver the congratulatory wreath to the park's owner, #r#eMadame Ming#k#n.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann's wreath has been delivered to Madame Ming. Oddly, they seemed to be less than friendly with one another. Something's fishy...

0.0: Heeey! If it isn't my good friend... uh, Donald? No. Josephine! No. Krang? Is that right? I'm sure it's close enough. Ya gotta help me out, Krang!\r\n

yes.0: You heard about this new theme park that's opening up? Fantasy Theme World?
yes.1: It's another one of those Fantasy-brand parks, like the one in Malaysia, the one with all the bears! Who needs that many bears in one place?! Makes me sick, I tell ya. Bear sick. But, as a fellow theme-parker, I feel obliged to send a little gift to the owner.
yes.2: I could do it myself, of course, but... don't make me come up with an excuse, Krang. Just take the #b#ecable car#n#k on the right side of #e#rLudibrium#k#n over to Fantasy Theme World and deliver this plant-thing I found in the dumpst... flower shop.

no.0: What?! I am Spiegelmann! How could you possibly say no to this face?!

1.0: Welcome... to #eFantasy Theme World#n! The only place in Maple World where dreams come true. I see you've brought a gift!

yes.0: I'm guessing these are from Spiegelmann. They reek of jealousy and pomade.

npc.0: Why are you not taking those to Madame Ming? Take the #b#ecable car#n#k at the right end of #e#rLudibrium#k#n to get to Fantasy Theme World.

item.0: Welcome to Fantasy Theme World. Did you come empty-handed? For shame.

lost.0: Ah, come on! This is DEFINITELY not a trap! Just take these to Madame Ming in Fantasy Theme World. The cable car will take you right there.\n
